title: Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with lamb and a blend of root vegetables, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: 1. Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
7. Add the beef broth, red wine (if using), thyme, and bay leaves to the pot.
8. Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
9. Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
10. Braise the stew in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
11. Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
